evidence.user_decision: 2026-10-08 user: runtime AI must be Claude Code / Codex via the user's own CLI login, not API keys; deploy on both personal PC and private lab server
evidence.notes: Official CLI headless mode (-p, stream-json) run by the account owner for their own use. --bare cannot be used (it never reads OAuth). Auth via an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR logged in by the user, or a user-generated `claude setup-token` value stored outside the repo. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must never reach the child (it silently overrides the subscription). S01: third-party products may not offer claude.ai login to others unless approved — this platform is single-owner and never shares the login.
